exports.contract: PL-4 (2026-07-04): shared per-segment synthesis loop (sentence splitting, pause insertion, marker emission, _synthesize_one fallback, WAV save) extracted from ~300-line near-duplicates in _run_serve_job (warm-worker) and main() (one-shot); genuine per-caller differences (latent-cache staleness, marker flush behavior, error message detail, exception-to-outcome translation, default_voice_profile_dir fallback) passed as explicit params/callables, never inferred from a mode flag

Consolidated onto the plugin's standard try/except studio_plugin_sdk-then-app.studio_plugin_sdk resolution pattern via a new module-level _get_ctx() helper (matches bake.py/handler.py/segments.py/standard_handler.py/voice_adapter.py). Also fixed a return-shape mismatch: module-level resolve_voice_preview_inputs(profile_name) (raw app.engines.voice_engines fn, 2-tuple) replaced with ctx.resolve_voice_preview_inputs(profile_name) (app/studio_plugin_sdk/context.py, returns {voice_ref, voice_profile_dir}) at both call sites, unpacking + re-wrapping voice_profile_dir as Path. Deleted a dead no-op `_ = run_managed_subprocess_async` line and its import.

2026-07-11 (adversarial-review-fixes): extracted a _resolve_voice_inputs() helper wrapping ctx.resolve_voice_preview_inputs() in try/except that raises EngineExecutionError on failure (previously unguarded), eliminating duplicated dict-to-Path unwrap logic at both call sites.
